Commentary.Commentary: The English fielders make their way out in the middle. Followed by the Sri Lanka openers - Danushka Gunathilaka and Kusal Perera. David Willey to begin the proceedings.

Right. The target has been set. The Sri Lankan bowlers have done their job well here. Now can the batters rise to the occasion and chase down this huge target? While, the English will continue their domination with the ball with an experienced attack. Please stay tuned for more action.

Chameera and Fernando started really well for Sri Lanka and gave hardly anything away in the first four overs. However, Udana came in and gave away the momentum conceding 17 in his first. Wanindu Hasaranga who was impressive in the first two matches was taken to the cleaners by the English batsmen. The other bowlers bowled economically. Chameera was once again the pick of the bowlers as he picked up 4 wickets and put Sri Lanka back in the game picking up the crucial wickets of Morgan, Billings, Malan and Ali.

England openers started off slowly but took the charge once Udana came on. Bairstow and Malan built a 105-run partnership and spared no one. They took on each and every bowler they faced. Bairstow even brought up his fifty but got out immediately. David Malan and Livingstone had a good partnership where Malan played the aggressive role and smacked everyone getting in his way. Livingstone supported him well at the other end before getting out. England did lose wickets in quick succession towards the end. It was a batting collapse as Morgan, Ali and Malan had to depart. As Curran and Jordon played a cameo role and collected 17 runs off the last over. But  it was all about Malan's innings today as his knock of 76 runs helped England post a total of 180 runs for 6.

FOUR! Back-to-back boundaries! That was a copy-paste shot as the previous one. Low full toss on off, Chris Jordan again knocks it past extra cover for a boundary. Good finish to the end. 17 runs coming off it. England finish with 180.
FOUR! Boundary of the first ball for Jordan! Low full toss on off, Chris Jordan hammers it towards mid off for a boundary.
Length delivery on the pads, Curran misses his shot. The ball hits his thigh pad and the batters sneak a leg bye.
Back of a length around off, pulled way to deep square leg for a brace.

Length delivery on middle, Curran heaves it towards long on. There is some miscommunication in the deep. In the end, no one calls for the catch and the batters run two. Terrible fielding in the last couple of deliveries.

FOUR! Starts with a low full toss on leg, Curran whips it to deep square leg. The fielder was in tow minds there and decides to go for the catch at the last moment. His effort is in vain as the ball goes through him for a boundary.
Full and outside off, Curran thrashes it to covers for a single.
Chris Jordan walks out to bat.

OUT! CAUGHT! Chameera gets a four-wicket haul. He is so crucial in the death overs. He did his job so well today. He surely is delighted with his performance. Serves a length ball, on off, Ali pulls it hard hoping to go over the fence. But does not manage to get the distance as he wanted, as the ball finds Wanindu Hasaranga at deep mid-wicket near the boundary line who takes a comfortable catch.
Commentary.Howout: c Wanindu Hasaranga b Dushmantha Chameera

Commentary.Commentary: On off, kept out.
Sam Curran is the new batsman in.

OUT! CAUGHT! Malan has to walk back to the shed after an amazing performance with the blade. Chameera you beauty, he is on a roll here. He gets his third of the day. The slower ball is doing the trick for him. This time it is slower and outside off. Malan was commited to chase this one, as he does and looks to power it through the off side, but the ball goes off the toe end of the bat. And it flies high in the air as the fielder comes under it and takes a sharp catch.
Commentary.Howout: c Dasun Shanaka b Dushmantha Chameera

Commentary.Commentary: A length ball, outside off, Malan shuffles across and looks to paddle it over the keeper, but could not get the connection.
A full length ball, around middle, Malan flicks it through square leg for a couple.
Length ball,, on off, Ali works it through mid-wicket and gets a couple.
Fuller ball outside off, drilled to extra cover.
FOUR! UP AND OVER! Back of a length delivery outside off, Moeen Ali hops and stretches his arms out, slices it over point for a boundary.
Play and a miss! A short ball, on off, Ali looks to chase it but misses.
WIDE! A length ball down the leg side. Malan looks to flick but misses. Wide given.
On a length, on off, Malan pushes it to the off side for another single.
A length ball, on middle, Ali flicks it through square leg for a single. And gets off the mark straightaway.

OUT! CAUGHT! Two wickets in the over. A good comeback by Sri Lanka in this game. This time the skipper departs without troubling the scoreline much. A full length delivery, on the pads, Morgan stays back and clips it towards deep square leg. There was only one fielder on the leg side and Morgan paces it straight to him. Danushka Gunathilaka keeps his eyes on the ball, hops and takes a sharp catch near the boundary line.
Commentary.Howout: c Danushka Gunathilaka b Dushmantha Chameera

Commentary.Commentary: Moeen Ali is the next batsman in.
A length ball, on off, Malan drives it through mid on and gets a single.
A slower one yet again, Morgan chips it towards cover, the ball flies and lands in a vacant region. Sneaks a single.
A length ball, on off, Malan works it to sweep cover for a single.
Eoin Morgan comes out to bat at No.5.

OUT! CAUGHT! Sam Billings could not continue his form from the last game and has to walk back to the shed only for 2 runs. The slower delivery by Chameera does the trick. A touch short on off, Billings pulls it hard towards deep mid-wicket. The ball does not go the distance as the bolwer kills the pace. As Dasun Shanaka once again takes the catch, this one was travelling for quite sometime but takes a sharp catch in the end.
Commentary.Howout: c Dasun Shanaka b Dushmantha Chameera

Commentary.Commentary: Full length ball, on the pads, Malan looks to flick it but misses. The ball clips the pads and rolls to square leg, as the batters sneak single.
Low full toss, outside off, Malan slashes it towards sweeper cover and gets a single.
On off, kept out solidly.
A length ball, on off, Billings punches it to the off side for a single.
Back of a length ball, outside off, Malan pulls it through the mid-wicket region and gets a single.
A full length, ball, on off, Billings flicks it through mid-wicket for a single.
Sam Billings walks out to bat.

OUT! CAUGHT! Liam Livingstone has to depart early today. An important wicket for Sri Lanka, as they needed to find this breakthrough as soon as possible. Fernando gets his first wicket of the day. A low full toss, on off, Livingstone just chips it to the fielder at cover, Dasun Shanaka  who takes the simplest of catches.
Commentary.Howout: c Dasun Shanaka b Binura Fernando

Commentary.Commentary: Bowls a googly on off, Livingstone bunts it down to long on for a single. 18 runs off it.
Quicker on middle and leg, Malan drives it down to long on for a run.
SIX! CLOBBERED! Floated it up on middle and leg, Dawid Malan heaves it over long on for a maximum. He moves onto 68.
Loopy ball on middle, flicked to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Floated it up on middle, Malan sweeps it towards the deep mid-wicket region who parries it to the fielder covering up. The throw is not that great though and the batters run three.

SIX! CRUNCHED! Tossed up on middle, Dawid Malan waits for the ball to come, pulls it hard over deep mid-wicket for a maximum. He is not done yet. Wanindu Hasaranga who has been excellent this series so far have been very expensive today.
FOUR! He is enjoying himself out there in the middle! Shortish on middle, Liam Livingstone pulls it deep square leg and fetches himself another boundary. 11 off the over.
Short of a length on leg, Malan pulls it to deep mid-wicket for another single.
Back of a length on middle, pulled to the man at deep mid-wicket for a single.
FOUR! Clever! Length delivery on middle, Liam Livingstone shuffles across and paddle scoops it over the keeper's head for a boundary.
Length delivery on middle, worked towards mid-wicket for a single.
Back of a length delivery outside off, Malan gets an under edge as he looks to swing.
Binura Fernando is called back into the attack now.
On off, eased down to long off for a run.

Straighter delivery on off, Malan works it to the left of sweeper cover. He comes back for a second and reaches his fifty. The throw comes at the bowler's end but Livingstone is home. Superb innings from the southpaw. A fifty off 31 deliveries.
Floated it up on leg, Liam Livingstone charges down the track and lofts it to long on for a run.
Short outside off, Malan cuts it past point for a single.
Fuller on off, Malan drives it past extra cover who gets a hand on it. Two taken.
Tossed up on off, Livingstone punches it off the back foot to long off. A single taken.
Very full again on middle, Livingstone flicks it to deep mid-wicket and retains the strike.
Fuller length on off, pushed back to the bowler.
The next batsman to walk in at No. 3 is Liam Livingstone.

OUT! TIMBER! Isuru Udana gets the first breakthrough! Low full toss on off, Jonny Bairstow skips a few steps as he looks to flick. He completely mistimes his shot and the ball disturbs the off pole. He cannot believe it. Bairstow departs after a wonderful knock. He has given the start England wanted. A crucial partnership broken.
Slower delivery on off, Malan hops and knocks it on the leg side. A run taken.
Darts a yorker on leg, Malan squeezes it towards the mid on region. Bairstow wants two and comfortably taken.
FOUR! Deft touch! Length delivery on off, Dawid Malan cleverly taps it towards third man for a boundary. Isuru Udana has been expensive tonight.
On middle, pushed back to the bowler.
Tossed up on off, driven towards covers for a single.
Quicker one on middle, Malan pushes it back to the bowler.
Outside off, blocked out to the off side.
FOUR! Top Shot! Shorter and outside off, Dawid Malan punches it towards point for a boundary.
Outside off, Malan looks to reverse sweep it but misses.
FOUR! What a way to get to your 50. A length ball, on off, Jonny Bairstow stays back and punches it through cover for a boundary.
A length ball, outside off, Bairstow pushes it through the cover region. The batters come back comfortably for second.
A yorker, on the money. Bairstow digs it out in time.
Play and a miss! Good length ball, outside off, Bairstow looks to chase it but misses.
A length ball, on off, Bairstow cuts it through cover for a couple.

SIX! Oh dear! Length delivery on middle, Jonny Bairstow powers it to deep square leg. Wanindu Hasaranga tries to catch the ball as he jumps but touches the cushions as he grabs it. Good effort but in vain.
Isuru Udana comes back into the attack.
FOUR! Brilliant batting! Tossed up on middle and off, Dawid Malan plays an inside-out shot clearing the infield for another boundary.
SIX! DISPATCHED! Floated delivery on middle, Dawid Malan muscles it over deep square leg for a biggie.
Fuller on middle, eased down to long on for a single.
Loopy ball on off, Malan hits it uppishly towards deep cover for a single.
FOUR! Slower through the air on middle, Dawid Malan reverse sweeps it firmly to deep point and fetches himself a boundary. Excellent placement from the no.1 T20 batsman.
Tossed up on off, worked towards deep point for a single.
Floated on the pads, Bairstow looks to flick but misses. The ball clips off the pads and rolls to the leg side. A single taken. Umpire signals a leg bye.
Loopy ball, outside off, Malan punches it through cover and gets a single.
Tossed up, on off, Bairstow pushes it to long off for a single.
Flatter, on off, Bairstow cuts it through cover for another couple.

In the air.. Safe! Loopy ball, on off, Bairstow comes down the track and swings his balde in hope. He gets an outside edge as the ball flies over the short third man. The ball lands in a vacant area. Two runs taken.
Floated on off, Jonny Bairstow defends it to cover.
Floated, on off, Malan flicks it through mid-wicket for a couple.
Tossed up, on off, Bairstow flicks it to the leg side for a single.
On off, kept out.
Loopy ball, on off, Malan comes forward pushes to long off. Single taken.
Floated, full and on off, Bairstow drives it down the ground towards long on for a single.
Loopy ball, on off, Jonny Bairstow pulls it past mid on for a couple.
Wanindu Hasaranga to come into the attack now.
Loopy ball on middle, worked to mid-wicket for a run. End of the powerplay. England 48 for none.
Tossed up on off, pushed to mid off.
FOUR! Fuller ball outside off, Jonny Bairstow punches it past covers for a boundary.
Flatter delivery on off, Bairstow chops it to the off side.
Touch short outside off, Bairstow cuts it to point.
FOUR! Welcomes him with a boundary! Fuller on off, Jonny Bairstow works it towards long off for a boundary.
Lakshan Sandakan comes to work his spin now. He replaces Binura Fernando.
The last over comprised of 10 balls instead of 6. Not the start Isuru Udana wanted.
Length and outside off, Malan looks to defend but goes off the outside edge towards short third man.
FOUR! Excellent! Fuller length on leg, Dawid Malan heaves it over mid-wicket for a boundary. 17 runs off the over already. Expensive from Isuru Udana.
WIDE! AND ANOTHER! Down the leg side again, Malan misses his flick. Wided. Couple of good overs at the start for Sri Lanka and Udana concedes 13 so far.
WIDE! Very full but down the leg side. The umpire signals it as wide.
Width on offer outside off, Bairstow square cuts it along the ground for a single.
Back of a length on off, Bairstow punches it towards covers.
Length delivery on off, punched to point.
FIVE WIDES! Udana is under pressure straightaway! Down the leg side, Bairstow misses his flick. The keeper cannot collect it and the ball goes to the fine leg fence.
FOUR! Length delivery on off, Jonny Bairstow lofts it over the covers for a boundary. Excellent start!
WIDE! Starts with a length delivery down the leg, Bairstow misses his flick. Wided.
Isuru Udana comes into the attack now. Replaces Dushmantha Chameera.
Play and a miss! on a length, outside off, Malan looks to chase it but misses as the ball bounces over the blade. A good recovery by Binura Fernando.
Good length ball, on off, Malan is solid in his defense.
Back of a length ball, on middle and off, Malan looks to pull it away but gets an inside edge as the ball rolls to the off side.
Good length ball, on off, Jonny Bairstow pulls it to the leg side and gets a single.
A length ball, around middle, Malan flicks it through mid-wicket for a single.
SIX! Pure timing from Dawid Malan. A full length ball, on the pads. Malan waits and clips it with poise as the ball ends up in the stands at deep mid-wicket for a maximum.
A single to end the over! A length ball, on off, Malan drives it to mid off for another single. Good running.
Touch and Run! Good length ball, on off, Bairstow pushes it to cover and takes off for a single.
Serves a slower delivery this time on a length, on off, Jonny Bairstow stays back and defends it to the off side.
A length ball, on off, Malan pulls it to square leg for a single.
A touch fuller, around off, Bairstow swings his balde but does not connect it well. The ball takes the outside edge and goes towards third man and gets a single.
FOUR! HAMMERED! A length ball, on off, Bairstow stands and delivers it over the bowler's head for a boundary.
Short of a length on off, Malan leaves it for the keeper to collect. Another good over for Sri Lanka. 6 runs off the first two overs.
Length delivery outside off, Malan watches the ball pass by.
The physio is out as Binura Fernando falls down holding the back of his leg. Everything seems to be fine, as he gets up to continue his spell.

Short of a length on off, Bairstow taps it onto the pitch. Malan calls for a quick single and gets across the line of Fernando who runs to grab the ball. He shoulders Malan in the process and he's down. He seems okay though.
Fuller length on middle, nipping in, Bairstow whips it towards mid-wicket for two.
Length delivery on off, Bairstow gets hit on the thigh pad as he strides forward.
Back of a length on off, Bairstow taps it to point.
Who will bowl from the other end? It is Binura Fernando to start his spell.
On a length outside off, Bairstow cuts but misses. The ball goes off the outside edge to third man. He retains the strike. Good first over from Chameera.
Swing and a miss! Good control from Chameera! Similar length to the previous delivery, Bairstow again goes for the drive but misses.
BEATEN! Good length ball on off, Bairstow went for the drive but gets beaten on the outside edge.
Length delivery on middle, Malan tucks it towards mid-wicket. He is off the mark with a single.
Fuller length on off, Bairstow pushes it to the man at mid off. A single taken.
Good length delivery outside off, Bairstow leaves it untouched.

The game is set to begin. The Sri Lankan players have made their way out in the field. Followed by Jonny Bairstow and Dawid Malan the two men to open for England. Dushmantha Chameera to start with the ball.

ENGLAND (PLAYING XI) - Jonny Bairstow (WK), Dawid Malan, Liam Livingstone, Eoin Morgan (C), Sam Billings, Moeen Ali (IN PLACE OF JASON ROY), Sam Curran, Chris Woakes (IN PLACE OF MARK WOOD), David Willey, Chris Jordan, Adil Rashid.

SRI LANKA (PLAYING XI) -  Kusal Perera (C), Danushka Gunathilaka, Oshada Fernando (IN PLACE OF AVISHKA FERNANDO), Kusal Mendis, Niroshan Dickwella (WK), Dasun Shanaka, Wanindu Hasaranga, Isuru Udana, Binura Fernando, Lakshan Sandakan (IN PLACE OF AKILA DHANANJAYA), Dushmantha Chameera.
TOSS - The coin goes up and falls in the favour of Sri Lanka. They opt to bowl first.

Hello and welcome to the last match of the T20I series where England will once again lock horns with Sri Lanka. England have already taken an unassailable 2-0 lead and sealed the series. Sri Lanka on the other hand, were beaten comprehensively by the Brits in the first match but gave a tough fight in the second game but only until the rain gods interrupted the game. The onus will be on the experienced batsmen to deliver a match winning performance for Sri Lanka to avoid a 3-0 loss. Will the Three Lions complete a whitewash? Or will the Islanders get a consolation win? We shall find out soon. Please stay tuned for more updates.
